Composer- und npm-Pakete gehen an OSV, W: Composer and npm packages are queried against OSV, while WordPress components are queried against the NVD. Each source is asked only about ecosystems it indexes: the NVD does not index Composer packages under those names, and OSV returns an empty response for every WordPress plugin query, which would look like a clean pass. Without an API key the NVD allows five requests per 30 seconds, so each run checks a slice of the inventory and remembers its cursor.
Eine nicht geprüfte Komponente ist keine: An unchecked component is not a clean component.

WordPress, aktive Plugins (Website und N: WordPress core, active plugins (site and network), must-use plugins, the active theme, and its parent theme using file header metadata; plus bundled Composer and npm lockfile libraries and the underlying runtime (PHP, versioned extensions, database server). Inactive plugins are excluded.
Listet die Hash-Verfahren, Chiffren und: Lists the hash algorithms, ciphers, and TLS versions offered by this server — including legacy ones, which is the purpose of a cryptographic inventory. On a typical PHP 8.3 host with OpenSSL 3.5 this adds roughly 186 entries, so it is disabled by default.

Standardmäßig sind die Endpunkte geschüt: By default, endpoints require an administrator session or Authorization: Bearer <token>. When public access is enabled, a 1-hour transient cache and a rate limit of 60 requests per minute apply.

Verordnung (EU) 2024/2847 über horizonta: Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 on horizontal cybersecurity requirements for products with digital elements. It applies from December 11, 2027, with Article 14 reporting obligations applying from September 11, 2026 (Article 71). This plugin does not assess whether it applies to a website.
Eine formale Aufzeichnung der Komponente: A formal record of software components and their supply chain relationships (Article 3(39) CRA). Under Annex I Part II, manufacturers must draw up an SBOM covering at least top-level dependencies; public disclosure is not required.
Maschinenlesbares Format für Software-St: Machine-readable software bill of materials format. Technical Guideline BSI TR-03183-2 describes mapping its data fields to CycloneDX and SPDX; according to the BSI, it is non-binding guidance.
Textdatei unter /.well-known/security.tx: Plain-text file at /.well-known/security.txt containing contact details and an expiration timestamp so vulnerability reports reach the right team.
Common Security Advisory Framework (OASI: Common Security Advisory Framework (OASIS): machine-readable format for security advisories. This plugin stores advisories using the base profile and does not publish provider-metadata.json.
